title: The idea of isolation and least privilege

videos.script: In lesson 4, a bug in the portal could not read the salaries file. Nobody stopped it in the act. The account the portal runs as had simply never been given that file. {{lesson4}} That is least privilege. Every person and every program gets what its job needs, and nothing more. {{principle}} In this lesson you will see what the portal holds on the server, and what it does not. You will see what ana may do as administrator, and what she may not. {{lab}} Then two ideas that grow from the same root. Separation of duties, where one person cannot do a dangerous thing alone. And isolation, where a program is kept in a box it cannot see out of. {{ideas}} Last, the slow leak every organisation has. Access that people collect and never give back. {{creep}}
